ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, two small balls can be seen on a smooth horizontal surface, the left side is labeled A, the right side is labeled B, and a spring is clamped in the middle; the problem statement explains that they were originally constrained by a thin string, and the spring is in a compressed state. Then reason: After the thin string is burned through, take the “spring and the two small balls” as one system. During the process in which the spring returns to its original length, the external forces on the system are mainly gravity and the supporting force of the horizontal surface; since the small balls move in the horizontal direction, gravity and the supporting force do no work, and the smooth horizontal surface also has no friction force doing work. The elastic force of the spring is an internal force of the system, and the work it does only converts the elastic potential energy of the spring into the kinetic energy of the two small balls, without changing the total mechanical energy of the system. Therefore, the mechanical energy of this system is conserved.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认A、B两个小球位于光滑水平面上，中间夹着被压缩的弹簧并由细线约束；从题干读取烧断细线后，考察对象是“弹簧和两个小球组成的系统”，过程是弹簧恢复原长。判断该系统所受外力只有重力和支持力，且在水平位移过程中二者不做功；系统内部的弹簧弹力虽做功，但只是把弹簧弹性势能转化为两球动能。因此系统机械能不因外力或非保守力做功而改变，结论为机械能守恒。
